title: 64-Orb Combo Hook into Rising Merges and Power-Ups

clips.why: Opens on the explosive 64-orb COMBO x2! (+128) merge halfway to the 128 goal.
Shows clean drag-and-drop aiming as two 8-orbs merge into 16.
Demonstrates chain merging with a COMBO x2! into an 8-orb.
Highlights the BIG MERGE! into a 32-orb and Bomb power-up unlock.
Shows the Bomb power-up clearing surrounding orbs with BOOM! +42.
Tightens the 16-orb merge into a second 32-orb to show steady progression.
Escalates into SPEED UP! mode with a fast COMBO x2! chain merge.
Displays the final score, best orb 64, and PLAY NOW call to action.
